cases.setup: PRAGMA page_size=512;CREATE TABLE l(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,k INTEGER);CREATE TABLE r(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,k INTEGER);INSERT INTO l VALUES(1,2);INSERT INTO r VALUES(1,0);INSERT INTO l VALUES(2,-3);INSERT INTO r VALUES(2,3);INSERT INTO l VALUES(3,-9223372036854775808);INSERT INTO r VALUES(3,2);INSERT INTO l VALUES(4,3);INSERT INTO r VALUES(4,5);
cases.sql: SELECT abs(a.k),a.id,b.id FROM l a JOIN r b ON a.id=b.k+1 ORDER BY a.id DESC,b.id LIMIT 1;
